paite: Huan Ahab in Samaria ah tapa sawmsagih anei hi. Jehu in Samaria a, Jezreel kho heutute, upate leh Ahab tapate ana dontei mite kiang ah, laigelh in akhak hi.
heading: Ahab Suante Thah Ahi Uh

paite: "Hiai laikhakte na muh phet chiang un, na pu tapate na kiang uah a-om ua, kangtalaite, sakolte, kulhpi nei khuate leng, galvante toh na nei uhi.
Huchi in na pu tapate lak a mi, ahoihpen leh akizenpen zongkhia unla, apa laltutphah ah tusak unla, na pu uh inkote a ding in gal dou un," achi hi.
Himahleh amau alau mahmah ua, "Ngai dih ua, kumpipa nihte'n azoh louhsa uh ahi a, e'n bangchi in i zou mahmah dia?" achi uhi.

Kumpipa insung heutupen, khopi ukpen, upate, naupangte ana dawntei mi teng in Jehu kiang ah, "Na sikhate ka hi uh, hih dia na hon hilh tengteng ka hih ding uh. Kuamah kumpipa in ka bawl kei ding uh; nang hoih na sakdan in hih in," chi in mi asawl uhi.

Akiang uah, "Kei lam a pang na hih ua, ka thu na man ding uleh na pute uh tapate lu hon la unla, zingchiang in hichih hun ma in Jezreel ah ka kiang ah hong un," chi in lai akhak nawn hi. Kumpipa tapate sawmsagih ahi ua, khopi miliante, amau dontei mite kiang ah a-om uhi.
Laikhak amuh un hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa tapate aman ua, sawmsagihte athat ua, alute uh bawmpi a koih in Jezreel ah akiang ah akhakta uhi.
Thangkou khat ahong tung a, "Kumpipa tapate lu ahon tawita uh," chi in ahilh uh. Ama'n, "Kulh lutna kongpi gei ah mun nih in sekhawm unla, zingchiang tan in om hen," achi hi.
Azingchiang in hichi ahong hi a, ava pawt a, adingh a, mi tengteng kiang ah, "Noute diktat hi un, ngai un, ka pu ka guksawm a, ka hihlumta a; ahihleh hiai tengteng kua thah ahia le?
TOUPA'N Ahab inkote tungtang agen, TOUPA thu lei ah ake het kei ding chih thei un; TOUPA'N asikha Elijah zang a agen ahon tungsakta hi," achi hi.
Huchi in Jehu in Jezreel a Ahab inkuan a mi omsun teng, amilian tengteng, alawm tengteng leh asiampute khat lel leng hawisak het lou in athat siang vek hi.
Huchi in athou a, apawt a, Samaria ah ahohta hi. Lampi a belampute belam mulmetna inn ava tun in,
heading: Kumpipa Ahaziah Tanaute Thah Ahi Uh

paite: Jehu in Judah kumpipa Ahaziah unaute amu a, "Kuate na hi ua?" achi hi. Amau, "Ahaziah unaute ka hi uh, kumpipa tapate leh kumpinu tapate chibai va buk dia paisuk ka hi uh," chi in adawng uh.
Ama'n, "Hingmat un," achi a; huchi in ahingmat ua, belam mulmetna inn khukchin ah athat ua, mi sawmli-le-nih ahi ua; khat lel leng ahawi kei uh.

Huai a pan apawt nung in Rekab tapa Jehonadab, amah dawn dia hong pai amu hi. Chibai abuk a, akiang ah, "Na tung a lungsim dik ka put bang in, lungsim dik na pu sam hia?” achi hi. Jehonadab in, “Pu e,” chi in adawng hi. "Ahihleh na khut hon pe dih," achi a; huchi in akhut apia a, ama'n akiang ah kangtalai sung ah akailut hi.
heading: Ahab Tanau Om Lai Teng Thah Ahi Uh

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hong sam inla, TOUPA a dia phatuam ka ngaihdan mu himhim dih,” achi hi. Huchi in akangtalai ah atuangsak hi.
Samaria ava tun in Ahab inkote Samaria a omsunte, Elijah kiang a agen TOUPA thu bang ngei in, ahihman khit vek masiah athat zel hi.
Jehu in mite tengteng asamkhawm a, akiang uah, Ahab in Baal nna sem zek phet ahi a, Jehu in bel nakpi in asem ding hi.
heading: Baal Bemite Thah Ahi Uh

paite: "Tu in Baal zawlnei tengteng, abemi tengteng leh asiampu tengteng ka kiang ah hon samkhawm dih ua. Kuamah kim lou kei uhen; Baal kiang ah kithoihna thupitak lat ding ka nei a; kuapeuh akim lou ahing het kei ding," achi hi. Himahleh Jehu in Baal bemite hihlup tum in, gitlouh piltak a, ahih ahi.
Jehu in, "Baal min in khawmpi thupi bawl un,” achi hi. Huchi in agenzakta uhi.
Jehu in Israel gam tengteng ah akhakkhia a; huchi in Baal bemi tengteng ahong pai ua, atel lou himhim a-om kei uhi. Baal inn ah alut ua; Baal inn kongpi a pan aphaitam pha in adim dipdep uhi.
Kivatna puan kemmi kiang ah, "Baal bemi tengteng kivatna puan hon la in," achi hi. Huchi in kivatna puante ahon la uhi.
Rekab tapa Jehonadab toh Baal inn ah Jehu alut ua; Baal bemite kiang ah, "Hiai ah Baal bemite lou ngal, TOUPA mite a-om kha ding uh, zong unla, en vialvial dih uh," achi hi.

Kithoihnate leh halmang thillatte lan dia alut un, Jehu in inkuan ah mi sawmgiat ana dingsak khin hi. "Na khut ua ka hon piak kuapeuh asuahtakleh, asuaktami hinna tang a amah hinna lak ding ahi,” achi hi.

Haltum thillat alat khittak in hichi ahong hi a, Jehu in galvil sepaih leh aheutute uh kiang ah, "Lut unla, va that un; kuamah suaktasak kei un," achi hi. Huchi in namsau in asat ua; galvil sepaih leh aheutute uh apaikhia ua, Baal inn ah alut uhi.
Baal inn a milimte alakhia ua, ahal uhi.
Baal lim alaichim ua, Baal inn ahihsia ua, tuni tan in dailenbuk in azang lai uhi.
Huchibang in Jehu in Israel gam a pan Baal ahihsia hi.
Himahleh Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhna, Israelte thil ahihkhialsak a, ahihte Jehu in atawpsan kei hi. Huai bel Bethel khua leh Dan a dangka-eng bawngnou limte biak ahi.

TOUPA'N Jehu kiang ah, "Ka mit tungtak a thil na hih ziak leh ka lungsim a deihthusam bangtak a Ahab inkote tung a na hih ziak in, na tapate suan lina tan in Israel laltutphah ah atu ding uh," achi hi.
Himahleh Jehu in TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian dan alungtang tengteng in azui kei a; Jeroboam in Israelte thil hihkhialsak a, ahihkhelh atawpsan tuan kei hi.
Huai lai in TOUPA'N Israel gam letdan aneusak panta hi. Huchi in Hazael in Israel gam tengteng ah amau anuaisiahta hi.
heading: Jehu Sihna

paite: Jordan a pan suahlam, Gilead gam tengteng, Gadte, Reubente, Manassehte, Arnon Phaizang a Aroer a pan Gilead leh Vasan gam tan in.
Jehu tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng, athilhihtheihdan tengteng Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Jehu api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, Samaria ah avui ua; asik in atapa Jehoahaz ahong lalta hi.
Samaria gam a Israelte tung a Jehu vaihawm sung kum sawmnih-le-giat ahi.
